blocks.text: Goal: stances stop being effortful and become your default posture.

blocks.heading: Warm-up · 0–3 min
rows: Ankle circles, hip circles, arm swings
Hold Ju Choom Sogi (horse stance): 3x 20 sec, reset each time

blocks.heading: Basics · 3–10 min
rows: Step into Jun Kul Sogi (long front stance) — footwork only, 10 reps/side
Add Ha Dan Makgi (low block) to the step, 10 reps/side

blocks.heading: Forms · 10–15 min
rows: Jung Kwon Jirugi (middle punch) with the same step, 10 reps/side
Finish: 5 slow exaggerated reps of block + punch — form over speed

cards.title: Block B · Days 6–10
cards.subtitle: Combine block + punch, add Kibon Il Bu

blocks.text: Goal: link block and punch into one rhythm; start the first form.

blocks.heading: Basics · 3–10 min
rows: Step forward, long front stance + low block
From same stance, punch (no stepping) — 8 reps/side

blocks.heading: Forms · 10–15 min
rows: Begin Ki Cho Hyung Il Bu (Basic Form 1)
Traces an "I" shape: left first, return, then centre line
Learn movements 1–8 (first half) only this block
Walk through slowly, check stance + hands each step
